title.narrative: Empowering children and young people to combat all forms of sexual exploitation in the Philippines
Stärkung von Kindern und Jugendlichen zur Bekämpfung aller Formen sexueller Ausbeutung in den Philippinen

description.narrative: Das Projekt leistet ein Beitrag zur Verbesserung des Schutzes von Kindern und Jugendlichen vor sexuellem Online Missbrauch sowie aller Formen von Gewalt und Ausbeutung. Es nimmt auch die Auswirkungen der Klimakrise in den Blick, von denen insbesondere die vulnerabelsten Bevölkerungsgruppen betroffen sind. The project contributes to improving the protection of children and young people from online sexual abuse and all forms of violence and exploitation. It also focuses on the effects of the climate crisis, which particularly affect the most vulnerable population groups. Children and young people from these population groups are disproportionately affected by online sexual abuse. The project organiser involves so-called child and youth advocates in project planning and implementation, thus ensuring the participation of the target groups and beneficiaries.
